install: python3 -m py_compile build_program.py normalize.py && if [ ! -d node_modules/playwright ]; then if node -e "require('dns').lookup('registry.npmjs.org', e => process.exit(e ? 1 : 0))" 2>/dev/null; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && ([ -n "${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-}" ] && [ -d "${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH}" ] || npx --yes playwright install chromium); else echo 'Skipping npm ci: registry.npmjs.org unreachable'; fi; fi
